howto.what: 安装后，Claude 可以访问 Example Engineering Blog 的 RSS 订阅内容，包括文章列表、作者信息、标签等，并能根据你的要求查找或总结相关文章。
howto.when: 当你询问关于 Example Engineering Blog 的文章、作者、标签或特定主题时，Claude 会使用该技能获取信息。

say.text: Example Engineering Blog 最近有哪些文章？
say.note: Claude 会列出最近的文章标题和摘要。

say.text: 查找关于 Python 的文章。
say.note: Claude 会筛选出 Python 分类下的文章。

say.text: Jane Doe 写了哪些文章？
say.note: Claude 会列出该作者的所有文章。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can access the RSS feed of Example Engineering Blog, including article lists, author info, tags, etc., and can search or summarize articles based on your requests.
howto.when_en: When you ask about articles, authors, tags, or specific topics from Example Engineering Blog, Claude will use this skill to retrieve information.

say_en.text: What are the recent articles on Example Engineering Blog?
say_en.note: Claude will list recent article titles and summaries.
Claude will filter articles under the Python category.

say_en.text: What articles did Jane Doe write?
say_en.note: Claude will list all articles by that author.
